_about: What each table row does, for the app to apply. The text shown is always the book's (data/generated). Keys are the book's own row labels, so a renamed row fails the tests. Effects: parts, xp, status, next (starts the next battle), tag, contact, rival, rumour, silly, item (gain: key or kinds/source/maxPrice, fit), loseItem, sellItem, buyItem, hire (an offer: discount or free), relicLead, sellerFound, noTasks, noTask, gift, healInjury, prosthetic, allLaidUpToSore, injury, injuryRoll (Light/Heavy list, or glitches for bots), reroll, dead, leave, title, finds, drop, d6, test, choice, recharge (Energy, or 'full'; who), taskPay (0, 0.5, 2 or 'failure'), noFinds, retest, swapAdvance, note. who: self, choose, all, patient, teacher, captain, lowestXp, evacuated, legend, bot, type:<Type>. prize / finalPrize: the battle's prize (11.5) and the Final's (15.3).

_decisions.text: Row 7: Ledgerhands 5, Twist success: the crew takes the boots (a copy armour worth up to 5 parts) and gains Butchers, and takes a copy weapon worth up to 5 parts as well.
Row 6 event 4, Twist success: "Fighter of the Year" is a title the legend takes.
When the crew gains a fourth contact, the player chooses which one it replaces.
The ransom card asks for the captor's faction: when it is the Ledgerhands, the ransom cannot be declined.
Fined anyway: the app asks how much of the second half of the price the owner actually paid (as much as it has).
